title: SaaS Churn & Retention Analysis by Segment
user_query: Analyze SaaS churn, ARR exposure, and subscription retention by segment

steps.title: Total Active Subscriptions
steps.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'Active'
steps.executed_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'Active' LIMIT 2000
steps.operation: SQLITE SELECT + Z-Score & Moving Average Enrichment

steps.title: Total Churned Subscriptions
steps.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions WHERE churn_date IS NOT NULL
steps.executed_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions WHERE NOT churn_date IS NULL LIMIT 2000
steps.operation: SQLITE SELECT + Z-Score & Moving Average Enrichment

steps.title: Average Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)
steps.sql_query: SELECT plan_tier, ROUND(AVG(mrr_usd), 2) AS avg_mrr FROM subscriptions GROUP BY plan_tier
steps.executed_sql: SELECT plan_tier, ROUND(AVG(mrr_usd), 2) AS avg_mrr FROM subscriptions GROUP BY plan_tier LIMIT 2000
steps.operation: SQLITE SELECT + Z-Score & Moving Average Enrichment

steps.title: Total ARR Exposure
steps.operation: SQLITE SELECT + Z-Score & Moving Average Enrichment

steps.title: Monthly Net Revenue & Profit Trajectory
steps.sql_query: SELECT order_month, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue, ROUND(SUM(profit_usd), 2) AS net_profit FROM orders GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month
steps.executed_sql: SELECT order_month, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue, ROUND(SUM(profit_usd), 2) AS net_profit FROM orders GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month LIMIT 2000
steps.operation: SQLITE SELECT + Z-Score & Moving Average Enrichment

steps.title: Churned ARR by Root Cause
steps.sql_query: SELECT churn_reason, ROUND(SUM(arr_usd), 2) AS churned_arr, COUNT(*) AS churned_accounts FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'Churned' AND churn_reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY churn_reason ORDER BY churned_arr DESC
steps.executed_sql: SELECT churn_reason, ROUND(SUM(arr_usd), 2) AS churned_arr, COUNT(*) AS churned_accounts FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'Churned' AND NOT churn_reason IS NULL GROUP BY churn_reason ORDER BY churned_arr DESC LIMIT 2000
steps.operation: SQLITE SELECT + Z-Score & Moving Average Enrichment

steps.title: Subscription ARR by Segment & Status
steps.sql_query: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Active' THEN s.arr_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS active_arr, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Expanded' THEN s.arr_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS expanded_arr, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Churned' THEN s.arr_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS churned_arr FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY active_arr DESC
steps.executed_sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Active' THEN s.arr_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS active_arr, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Expanded' THEN s.arr_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS expanded_arr, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Churned' THEN s.arr_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS churned_arr FROM subscriptions AS s JOIN customers AS c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY active_arr DESC LIMIT 2000
steps.operation: SQLITE SELECT + Z-Score & Moving Average Enrichment

steps.title: Segment to Product Category ARR Flow
steps.sql_query: SELECT c.segment, p.category, ROUND(SUM(s.arr_usd), 2) AS total_arr FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY c.segment, p.category ORDER BY total_arr DESC
steps.executed_sql: SELECT c.segment, p.category, ROUND(SUM(s.arr_usd), 2) AS total_arr FROM subscriptions AS s JOIN customers AS c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN products AS p ON s.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY c.segment, p.category ORDER BY total_arr DESC LIMIT 2000
steps.operation: SQLITE SELECT + Z-Score & Moving Average Enrichment

steps.title: High-Value Accounts & Subscription Ledger
steps.sql_query: SELECT c.company_name, c.segment, c.region, p.product_name, s.status, s.mrr_usd, s.arr_usd, c.account_health_score, COALESCE(s.churn_reason, 'Healthy') AS risk_note FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY s.arr_usd DESC LIMIT 50

executive_summary: Total active subscriptions remain stable at 245 with no change, but average monthly recurring revenue (MRR) has declined sharply by 82.31% to $2,599. Total ARR exposure stands at $15.00M with no change, while monthly net revenue shows a significant trajectory increase from $462.4K to $1.19M (+157.91%), indicating potential revenue volatility with an outlier spike in August 2026.

Monthly net revenue trajectory increased by 157.91% from $462.4K to $1.19M
Churned ARR ranges from $70.9K to $399.8K with a -82.26% trajectory
